email.subject: Anchor Co Plumbing: missing calls from mobile visitors
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I checked Anchor Co Plumbing's website. Two things are likely costing you jobs: it isn't optimized for mobile, where most people search for a plumber when they have an emergency, and there's no click-to-call button, so those visitors have to copy your number instead of just tapping to call. The site also has no online booking and loads slowly due to heavy images, which adds friction too.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
